$Comment: Reaching tiers on a track. Qualifier is the track id, and a step without one counts any track. With a Target (a Tiers entry of the track's curve) the step reads 1 once the player's best level reaches that tier, so write Amount 1. Without a Target it reads how many of the track's tiers the player has reached, so Amount 3 asks for three tiers. A step keeps the highest it has seen; it is restated at every login and whenever the best level rises, so a jump never misses a tier, a repeat changes nothing and a prestige never undoes it. A step reads {"Kind": "TRACK_TIER", "Target": "Adept", "Qualifier": "Your_Mining", "Amount": 1}.
